svg.text: ENTERPRISE COMPLEX EXCEL & MULTI-HEADER FINANCIAL TABLE RAG ARCHITECTURE
openpyxl Coordinate-AST Un-Merging + DuckDB Lifts Excel RAG Accuracy from 56.5% to 97.8%
100K Excel Workbooks / 600K Queries/Mo: Tier 1 Naive CSV Chunking (56.5% Acc) vs. Tier 2 VLM Screenshot ($210K/mo) vs. Tier 4 AST + DuckDB ($23K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: `Unnamed: 1` & Orphaned Rows
1. Naive `read_excel().to_csv()` + Text Chunking (56.5% Accuracy):
• 3-level merged headers (`FY26 -> Q3 -> Actuals $M`) turn into
`Unnamed: 1, NaN`; Rows #150–200 lose all column headers & units!
2. Vision VLM Screenshot RAG (Tier 2: $210,000/mo Token Bill):
• Cannot fit 500-row x 40-col spreadsheets into an image without
blurring numbers; hallucinates sums across 80 rows (24.5% error)
3. Raw `.xlsx` into Pandas REPL Without AST Un-Merge (Tier 3):
• Side-by-side sub-tables on one sheet break `df.columns` (4,800ms)
Production Failure Impact (100K Workbooks / 600K Queries/Mo):
• Complex Table QA Accuracy: Only 56.5% (Tier 1) | 72.0% (Tier 2)
• Arithmetic & Unit-Scale (`$K` vs `$M`) Errors: 38.4% (Tier 1)
• Monthly Compute & Financial Rework Cost: $195,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: openpyxl Coordinate-AST + Header + DuckDB
1. `openpyxl` Sub-Table Island Splitter & Merged-Cell Un-Merger:
• Detects multiple sub-tables per sheet via border/blank islands &
flattens merged headers into `FY26_Q3_Actuals_USD_Thousands`!
2. Indented Row-Hierarchy & Unit Multiplier Propagation:
• Propagates `Region: EMEA > Country: DE` & `scale=1,000` into every
row tuple so no row is ever orphaned from its header context
3. Dual-Index: Semantic Row Cards + Embedded `DuckDB / Parquet`:
• Runs exact `SUM / YoY` math in 8ms SQL (`0.2%` error, 390ms P95)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Complex Table QA Accuracy: 97.8% (+41.3 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Math & Unit Error Rate: 0.2% | Query P95 Latency: 390 ms
• Monthly Total TCO: $23,000 / mo (-88.2% savings vs. Tier 1)
